messages:
Alex M: Quick sync — building the Q3 model-catalog runway. Need to lock prioritization lanes, retire scheduling, and the emergency ripcord policy. Goal: minimize customer disruption while clearing tech debt.
Priya K: +1. Can we split entries into 'latency-sensitive', 'cost-sensitive', and 'batch' buckets? That affects pin windows and rollout cadence.
Jonah R: That's our plan. Latency-sensitive -> P95 target < 300ms on hosted; cost-sensitive -> economic parity with current v1 within 15% tokens cost; batch -> async TTLs.
Maya S: For onboarding acceptance: we should require a benchmark set (50 queries/sample of each traffic class), regression < 2% quality delta on held prompt set, and perf reports in perf-dashboard.
Samir D: Ops ask: map each new model to a hardware bucket (A100-80GB, H100-80GB, L4 etc). Retirement schedule must respect hardware affinity so customers on Dedicated don't see forced hw migration during contract windows.
Casey P: Comms: propose 60-day notice for retirements -> 30-day developer grace + 30-day customer migration window. For pinned versions customers get an opt-in migration plan and 6-week soft-pin before hard-deprecation.
Laila Z: Sales: add migration credits for enterprise customers on multi-model contracts. Also need an 'escape hatch' if model causes customer regressions — auto-roll to previous pinned variant for 72h.
Alex M: @engbot can we run a dry-canary config that flips 1% of prod requests to candidate and collects per-route latency, cost, and semantic-similarity drift? Need a sample config snippet for runbook.
engbot: Canary created: id=canary-3098765432, snapshot=2026-03-19, traffic=1%, metrics=[p95_latency, cost_per_token, semantic_cos_sim]. Logs: /canaries/3098765432.
Jonah R: Sample canary config for ops runbook: ```yaml
canary:
  id: canary-<ts>
  traffic_pct: 1
  duration: 48h
  metrics: [p95_latency, mean_cost, semantic_similarity]
  fallback: pin-to: previous-stable
```
Priya K: Pin policy proposal: soft-pin default 6 weeks for new entries -> if no regressions, auto-accept into catalog GA. Exceptions: enterprise-requested long-pins (up to 6 months) gated by contract.
Maya S: Deprecation criteria: detected infra-incompatibility, model-quality regression >5% on anchor tests, or security/compliance flags. For non-critical deprecations, staggered retirements across cohorts (10% of tenants/week) with rollback ops.
Samir D: Ripcord mechanics: product signals + ops manual trigger -> immediate 100% routing away to fallback pool, notify customers + open migration ticket, apply emergency migration credits. Must log to audit-trail and create postmortem.
Casey P: Launch gates checklist (short): 1) Benchmarks uploaded + pass thresholds, 2) Canary stable for 48h, 3) Rollout plan with hardware buckets, 4) Comms draft + SDK opt-in flag, 5) Escrowed rollback variant.
Laila Z: One ask from sales: allow a per-customer SDK flag `prefer_pin=true` so customer SDK can avoid auto-upgrades during gracepath. That preserves UX for big contracts.
Alex M: Agreed. Action items: Jonah+Maya to finalize bench thresholds doc by EOD Wed, Samir to outline ripcord runbook and hardware-bucket mapping by Fri, Casey to draft comms template and 60/30-day notice language. I'll compile and send to PM leadership.
Priya K: Also add a short-term metric: time-to-migrate (avg days) for customers moved off deprecated models — aim for <21 days.
Jonah R: Noted. I'll add telemetry hooks to perf-dashboard (per-tenant migration time).
Maya S: If anyone wants to review the bench sampling plan ping me. I'll also include sampling quotas so canaries don't skew billing. :rocket:
Samir D: Putting ripcord stub in runbook now. Will post link when done. :lock:
Casey P: Draft comms in #comms-drafts and will share here once ready.
Alex M: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for the roadmap snapshot. Ping me for clarifications. :thumbsup:
